For reference see 6.3.3: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x15-V6-Authentication.md#v63-general-authentication-security 

As ASVS L3 require hardware-based authentication, generally, this section needs to be changed.

|# | Description | Level | #v5.0.be|
|-- | -- | -- | --|
|7.5.3 | Verify that the application requires further authentication with at least one factor or secondary verification before performing highly sensitive transactions or operations. | 3 | v5.0.be-3.7.3|

I propose that it should be something like this:

|# | Description | Level | #v5.0.be|
|-- | -- | -- | --|
|7.5.3 | Verify that the application requires further authentication with a hardware-based authentication mechanism appropriate for L3 before performing highly sensitive transactions or operations. | 3 | v5.0.be-3.7.3|

previous_versions.body:
Intention here is not to be overprescriptive, and it is quite clear that "one size fits all" is impossible to achieve here.

The logic here should be:
* It must be analyzed (e.g., based on threat modelling) which kind of functionality is "sensitive" or "highly sensitive"
  * we have requirement for this for sensitive data (14.1.1, 14.1.2), not sure right now about "highly sensitive functionality"
* For each sensitive functionality, a protection level must be picked.
* The protection level must be implemented

If anything needs to be improved, it is the analysis documentation. The implementation requirement should not be overcooked with details to require it from everyone as it is valid only in certain cases.
